titulo: Composition: a car has an engine
enunciado: Model Engine (power, running) and Car which HAS an Engine and a mileage. Car.drive(km) only adds kilometers if the engine is running. Show the mileage before and after starting it.
objetivos: Build objects out of other objects (has-a relationship)
Delegate work to the contained object
pistas: The Car creates its Engine in the constructor.
To use the engine first store this.engine in a local variable: Engine m = this.engine;
Composition: the engine lives and dies with the car.
